sections.text: CIC::DUX4 acts as a transcriptional activator in CIC-rearranged sarcoma. In patient-derived cell models, fusion depletion reduced active chromatin and direct target-gene expression, including ETV1, ETV4 and ETV5; primary tumors shared the associated active chromatin pattern.

audit_evidence.scope: ChIP-seq and fusion depletion in patient-derived CDS cell lines plus primary tumor chromatin profiles: CIC-DUX4-associated active chromatin; direct targets including ETV1/4/5 decrease after depletion.

sections.text: In a retrospective comparison, a 57-patient CIC-rearranged sarcoma control cohort had worse overall survival than 22 followed patients with BCOR::CCNB3 sarcoma.

audit_evidence.scope: Indexed primary Results: BCOR exon 15-CCNB3 exon 5 junction, inversion FISH, distinct expression cluster; survival comparison of 22 followed BCS versus 57 historical CIC-rearranged controls and ES controls.

report_comment.text: CIC encodes capicua, an HMG-box transcriptional repressor. DUX4 encodes a double-homeobox transcription factor from a repetitive subtelomeric locus. CIC::DUX4 acts as a transcriptional activator in CIC-rearranged sarcoma. In patient-derived cell models, fusion depletion reduced active chromatin and direct target-gene expression, including ETV1, ETV4 and ETV5; primary tumors shared the associated active chromatin pattern. In a retrospective comparison, a 57-patient CIC-rearranged sarcoma control cohort had worse overall survival than 22 followed patients with BCOR::CCNB3 sarcoma.
